infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SM mart uses your location while you are delivering an order.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SM mart shares your location with the customer while an active delivery is in progress.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow SM mart Delivery to use your location during an active delivery.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SM mart Delivery to share your location during an active delivery.
